description_en: Obtains a list of endpoints of service groups
name: DescribeGroupEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The service group name. For more information about how to obtain the service group name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 群组名称。如何获取群组名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: group_name

Endpoints.description_en: The endpoints of the service group

BackendId.description_en:
The backend access ID, which varies based on the value of the EndpointType parameter.

If you set EndpointType to DefaultGateway, the value of this parameter is default.

If you set EndpointType to PrivateGateway, the value of this parameter is the ID of the dedicated gateway.

If you set EndpointType to Nlb, the value of this parameter is the ID of the NLB instance.

If you set EndpointType to Nacos, the value of this parameter is the ID of the Nacos instance
BackendId.description_zh:
后端接入ID，取决于EndpointType：
DefaultGateway：为default。
PrivateGateway：为专属网关ID。
Nlb：为NLB实例ID。
Nacos：为Nacos实例ID

EndpointType.description_en:
The service endpoint type. Valid values:

DefaultGateway: the shared gateway.

PrivateGateway: the dedicated gateway.

Nlb: Associate the service with the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance.

Nacos: Associate the service with the Nacos instance
EndpointType.description_zh:
服务端点接入方式，可能值为：
DefaultGateway：共享网关。
PrivateGateway：专属网关。
Nlb：挂载NLB。
Nacos：挂载Nacos

PathType.description_en:
The path type. Valid values:

Group: the path of the service group
PathType.description_zh:
地址类型，可能值为：
Group：服务群组地址

Port.description_en: The port number. This parameter takes effect only when you associate the service with an NLB or Nacos instance
Port.description_zh: 端口。仅挂载NlB和Nacos时，Port才有值

v1_parameters.help_en: The service group name. For more information about how to obtain the service group name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
